name: InstantMesh
tagline: Feed-forward 3D mesh generation framework creating textured 3D assets from a single image via multi-view diffusion.
real_test_summary: Tested generating multi-view consistent 3D OBJ and GLB assets locally from single reference images. Produces cleaner back-side geometry than single-step reconstruction models.
pros: Apache-2.0 open-source license with Gradio web demo and CLI
Exports standard OBJ and GLB meshes with vertex colors or UV textures
cons: Requires 8GB+ VRAM and takes longer per asset than TripoSR
Surface textures may need minor touch-ups for close-up rendering
